newsitem.title: USA: Iowa-S Minn cattle market not well tested - USDA.
newsitem.headline: Iowa-S Minn cattle market not well tested - USDA.

text.p: Slaughter steers and heifers were not well tested, compared with Tuesday's close, according to USDA. Trade was slow and demand light. Seller interest and offerings also were light. Steers: Select and Choice 2-4 1225-1275 lbs 67.00-67.50 Heifers: Select and Choice 2-4 1225 lbs few 67.00
On a carcass basis (weight only), compared with Tuesday's close, slaughter steers and heifers were not tested.

Steers: Select to mostly Choice 2-4 no sales. Holstein: (weight only) Select to mostly Choice 2-3 1250-1400 lbs no sales. Holsteins: ( grade & weight) Choice 2-3 1250-1450 lbs no sales Select 2-3 1250-1450 lbs no sales.
Heifers: Select and Choice 2-4 no sales
For the week: 10,000 Wk ago: 12,100 Yr ago: 34,300 Steers and heifers: Live basis: mostly steady. Carcass basis; mostly steady. Confirmed: 400 Week Ago: 8,600 Year Ago: 21,900
